quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

activation.condition: Pedestrian faces an official steady red signal alone at the highway entry.

obligation.description: Do not enter the highway while facing the steady red signal, subject to permission from another device under NRS 484B.283.

exceptions.trigger: Pedestrian is permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283.
exceptions.effect: The red-signal entry prohibition is subject to that permission.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Follow the applicable other-device indication under the referenced statute.
exceptions.source_clause: unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283

timing.description: Evaluate the facing signal and other-device indication at first full-body highway entry; retain earlier lawful entry and countdown clearance history.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
judgment_calls_needed.note: Permission depends on original device authority, indication, timing and the referenced subsection; no legal verdict is assigned.

parameter_refs.name: entry_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: request to wait or attempt entry; actual body movement is measured separately

parameter_refs.name: other_device_indication
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, WALK, flashing hand with countdown, flashing hand without countdown, or steady hand
